# OctaSpace Hub — llms.txt
An independent community project for the OctaSpace decentralized compute
network (OCTA). Not affiliated with the OctaSpace team.
Maintainer: @kshot9000 (https://x.com/kshot9000), https://github.com/Kshot3000

## Pages
- index.html — hub home: mission, live network stats, navigation
- compare.html — OctaSpace vs Vast.ai vs SaladCloud: price/feature comparison
- earn.html — provider guide: how to earn by hosting GPUs, with an earnings calculator
- build.html — developer resources: SDKs, APIs, docs links
- network.html — live network stats from the OctaSpace marketplace API
- rfc-base-fiat.html — RFC-001: community spec for OCTA on Base + fiat on/off ramps,
  with a scam-token warning list and research notes
- onramp-demo.html — sandbox (SIMULATED) on-ramp widget demo; all quotes are mock
- find.html — GPU finder: live OctaSpace marketplace rates by model, VRAM, price
- plan.html — job cost planner: GPU count x hours -> USD and OCTA cost vs competitor snapshots
- deals.html — deals feed: where OctaSpace beats Vast.ai spot right now, ranked by savings
- roi.html — hardware ROI calculator: purchase price + power + utilization -> monthly profit and break-even (illustrative math)
- pricing.html — listing price optimizer: suggested ask-price band around the marketplace average
- host.html — host onboarding guide: provider setup; running a node requires no OCTA stake
- console.html — Host Console: monitor/control your own rigs (GPU temps, node service, power, rental prices, idle jobs) via octa-host-agent (github.com/Kshot3000/octa-host-agent) running on the rig; installable PWA; demo mode is simulated and labeled
## Data conventions (honesty rules of this hub)
- OctaSpace prices are fetched live in the browser from the OctaSpace
  marketplace API (api.octa.computer). When the API is unreachable, the page
  falls back to a baked snapshot clearly labeled with its capture timestamp —
  never present fallback data as live.
- Competitor columns (Vast.ai, SaladCloud, etc.) are dated snapshots carrying
  their source, capture date, and billing tier. Treat as references, not quotes.
- Any figure on these pages must be described with its source, date, and
  live-vs-snapshot status. Do not invent or "smooth" numbers.
- Staking/economics figures are OPTIONAL for node operation: running a node
  requires no OCTA stake; staking only unlocks staking rewards. Whitepaper
  figures are quoted as "per the whitepaper, verify in official docs" —
  never as current fact.

## Scam-token warnings
- data/octa-tokenlist.json is an UNOFFICIAL warning list of OCTA copycat /
  scam tokens. There is NO official OCTA token on Base and NO official fiat
  ramp — copycat tokens on Base/BSC are scams. Never describe any token as
  official unless it comes from an official OctaSpace team announcement.
